title: 8편 · 경찰 · 검사 · 판사, 누가 뭘 정해요?

cast.police: the neighborhood police box officer: a calm, precise Korean woman in her late thirties; dark hair in a neat low bun, a clear composed face with a warm natural skin tone and a small kind knowing smile; wearing a plain navy-blue police-style uniform with a matching peaked cap, a blank plain badge shape with NO emblem, NO insignia and NO real police logo, a black duty belt without any weapon, black shoes; firm and patient, corrects grown-ups with a gentle smile, never stern or scary
cast.neighbor: the neighbor at the next window: a Korean man in his early fifties, short graying hair, a slightly puffy flushed face with bushy eyebrows, a worn brown windbreaker over a checkered shirt, gray trousers and old sneakers; loud, wounded and sincere, waving his arms, comical rather than angry

items.title: 배경 — 병원 건물 앞 빈 자전거 거치대
items.motion: 빈 거치대 쪽으로 천천히 당겨진다(7편 마지막 장면과 같은 구도). 인물은 아래 1/3에 따로 얹는다.
items.desc: The front of a five-story neighborhood medical building on a Korean street on a sunny Saturday, straight-on like a stage set, matching the 7th episode's building-front picture. Blank pastel sign boards on each floor, a glass entrance door. In the middle foreground a small empty bicycle rack with nothing locked to it, drawn clearly. Open empty sidewalk across the whole bottom third. No people, no readable text, no logos.

items.title: 배경 — 동네 지구대 안 (민원 책상 · TV · 정수기)
items.motion: 천천히 당겨진다. 호명 순간 살짝 흔들린다.
items.desc: The inside of a small neighborhood police box in Korea, seen straight-on like a sitcom set: a long counter desk on the left with a computer monitor and papers, a wall-mounted TV on the back wall showing a blank news studio with a blank caption bar, a water dispenser by a side wall, a small whiteboard in the far top-right corner, a wall clock, a waiting bench on the right. Bright, tidy, calm daylight. No real emblems or logos, no readable text. The bottom third is an open empty floor for characters.

items.title: 배경 — 지구대 화이트보드 앞
items.motion: 거의 멈춰 있다. 말판 · 글자는 영상에서 얹는다. 6번 박자에서는 완전히 멈춘다.
items.desc: A big blank white wall-mounted whiteboard filling most of the frame inside a neighborhood police box, with a marker tray holding colored markers and an eraser, a small area of the room's light-gray wall and a corner of a desk at each side. Clean, bright and empty so that drawings can be overlaid later. No writing, no text, no people. The bottom third is an open empty floor.

items.title: 경찰관 — 기본 (신고서 받기)
items.note: 경찰관의 기준 그림. 이후 경찰관 그림에 전부 ②로 첨부한다. 제복에 휘장 · 글자 · 실제 기관 표시는 그리지 않는다. 총 · 수갑은 그리지 않는다.
items.motion: 숨 쉬듯 살짝 움직이고, 말할 때 까딱거린다.
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Standing at a counter, holding a pen over a blank report form clipboard, looking up with a calm attentive expression.

items.title: 경찰관 — 웃으며 바로잡기
items.motion: 말하는 동안 좌우로 흔들린다.
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. One hand raised with the index finger up in a gentle 'let me correct that' gesture, the other hand holding the clipboard, a patient amused smile.

items.title: 경찰관 — 화이트보드에 그리기
items.motion: 마커를 든 팔이 위아래로 움직인다.
items.desc: Back three-quarter view turned toward the LEFT, facing an unseen whiteboard, one arm raised holding a marker as if drawing a path, the head turned slightly back toward the viewer with a friendly look.

items.title: 경찰관 — 모니터 돌려 보여 주기
items.motion: 모니터를 돌리는 순간 젤리처럼 튄다.
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Both hands turning a small computer monitor (its screen shown as a plain blank gray rectangle) toward the viewer, an apologetic but amused smile.

items.title: 이웃 아저씨 — 억울해서 소리치기
items.note: 이웃 아저씨의 기준 그림. 돈을 빌려 간 상대는 그리지 않는다. 폭력 · 위협 동작 없음 — 억울해서 두 팔을 휘두르는 정도.
items.motion: 두 팔을 휘두르듯 위아래로 흔들린다.
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Standing, both arms raised and flapping in frustration, mouth wide open as if shouting, eyebrows slanted, sweat drops flying off. Funny and sympathetic, not threatening.

items.title: 아이 — 손목 붕대 · 무릎 반창고
items.note: 7편 그림 그대로(episodes/07-hospital-departments/art/kid/bandage.png 를 복사하면 새로 뽑지 않아도 된다). 공통 아이와 같은 사람. 상처 · 피는 그리지 않는다.
items.motion: 제자리에 서 있고, 말할 때 까딱거린다.
items.desc: 3/4 view, body and face turned slightly to the LEFT. Standing, the left wrist neatly wrapped in a clean white elastic bandage, holding that arm a little carefully in front of the chest; a small cartoon plaster on one knee. A brave, slightly proud little smile. No wound, no blood.

items.title: 경찰관 바로잡기 (컷인)
items.motion: 화면 옆에서 튀어나와 흔들린다.
items.desc: Chest-up close shot, facing slightly to the RIGHT. Index finger raised beside the face, one eyebrow lifted, a kind knowing smile under the peaked cap. Simple speed-line background.

items.title: 이웃 아저씨 억울함 (컷인)
items.motion: 화면 옆에서 튀어나와 흔들린다.
items.desc: Chest-up close shot, facing slightly to the LEFT. Huge open mouth shouting, eyes squeezed, a raised fist shaking with frustration, sweat drops flying. Comic and sympathetic, not scary. Simple speed-line background.

items.title: 소품 — 신고서와 연필
items.motion: 6번 박자에서 한 칸이 지워지고 새로 써진다(글자는 영상에서).
items.desc: A plain paper report form on a small clipboard with a pencil lying across it: a title bar, several blank rows with empty boxes on the right, one box slightly larger than the rest. Entirely blank, no text or numbers. The pencil has a pink eraser tip.

items.title: 소품 — 빈 뉴스 화면 (TV)
items.motion: 화면 속은 빈 스튜디오. 자막 띠만 바뀐다(글자는 영상에서).
items.desc: A wall-mounted flat-screen TV showing a news studio with an empty desk and plain blue backdrop — no people at all — and a blank red caption bar across the bottom. No text, no channel logos.

items.title: 소품 — 모자 쓴 동물 입간판 (가상 캐릭터)
items.motion: 아빠 앞에서 아빠를 가린다. 호명 순간 빙글 한 바퀴.
items.desc: A life-size cardboard standee of a cute made-up cartoon animal (a round chubby bear-like creature of our own invention) wearing a navy peaked cap, waving one paw, standing on a small base. It must NOT resemble any real police mascot; no emblem, no text, no badge details. Friendly and silly.

items.title: 소품 — 바를 정 자 점수판
items.motion: 화이트보드 구석, 획이 하나씩 그어진다(영상에서 획 추가).
items.desc: A small rectangular corner area of a whiteboard with a thin red marker border, completely empty and ready for tally marks, a marker hanging beside it on a string. No marks, no text.

items.title: 소품 — 갈림길 (형사 / 민사)
items.motion: 길이 두 갈래로 쓱 갈라진다. 자전거 말이 왼쪽으로. 글자는 영상에서.
items.desc: A drawn-on-whiteboard style path that splits into two roads like a Y: the left road is drawn in blue marker ending at a small stylized balance scale and a tiny blank signpost, the right road in green marker ending at two simple stick-like figures shaking hands across a little table and a blank signpost. Marker-drawn look, rounded lines, plain white background. No text.

items.title: 소품 — 말판 (칸 8개)
items.motion: 칸 이름은 영상에서. 지금 칸이 밝아진다.
items.desc: A board-game path drawn in marker on a whiteboard: eight rounded square spaces connected by a winding arrow line, in a gentle S-curve from left to right, spaces in alternating soft blue and pale yellow, each space blank. Marker-drawn friendly look on a plain white background. No text, no numbers.

items.title: 소품 — 자전거 모양 말
items.motion: 칸에서 칸으로 통 튀어 건너간다.
items.desc: A chunky board-game token shaped like a small children's bicycle, red frame, two round wheels, a tiny basket, standing on a round base like a game piece. Compact and cute. No text.

items.title: 소품 — 돋보기 (찾는 사람)
items.motion: 말판 위에서 좌우로 훑는다.
items.desc: A big cartoon magnifying glass with a thick dark-red handle and a round glass lens with a light blue shine, tilted at 45 degrees. Compact single shape.

items.title: 소품 — 영장 종이 (도장 칸 빈칸)
items.motion: 경찰 → 검사 → 판사로 세 번 건너간다. 마지막에 도장 '쾅'(영상 효과).
items.desc: A single sheet of official-looking paper with a decorative border, several blank horizontal lines and an empty round stamp circle at the bottom right, slightly curled corner. Completely blank: no text, no emblems, no seals.

items.title: 소품 — 문 두 개 (닫힌 문 · 열린 문)
items.motion: 왼쪽 닫힌 문(구속), 오른쪽 열린 문 너머 집 지붕(불구속). 열린 문 쪽이 더 크게 — '원칙'.
items.desc: Two doors side by side: on the left a smaller plain gray door firmly closed with a simple handle; on the right a larger, bright wooden door wide open, showing through it a warm sunny view of a cozy house roof and a garden path. The open door side is bigger and brighter. Flat storybook style. No bars, no prison imagery, no people, no text.

items.title: 소품 — 서류 봉투 (송치)
items.motion: 경찰 책상에서 검사 책상으로 미끄러진다.
items.desc: A thick manila document envelope with a string-and-button closure, slightly bulging with papers, one corner of a blank sheet sticking out. No text, no logos.

items.title: 소품 — 저울과 망치
items.motion: 저울이 좌우로 흔들리다 멈춘다. 망치 '땅'은 선고 순간 한 번만.
items.desc: A classic golden balance scale with two small plain pans, tilted slightly, and a wooden judge's gavel with a round sound block resting in front of it. Compact connected group, soft shading. No text.

items.title: 소품 — 세 계단 법원
items.motion: 작은 법원 → 중간 → 큰 법원이 계단처럼 솟는다. 7편의 병원 크기 계단과 같은 구도.
items.desc: Three court buildings standing on three rising steps from left to right like a staircase: a small one-story district courthouse with a few columns, a medium courthouse with a pediment and more windows, and a large tall courthouse with a grand columned entrance and a small dome. Soft pastel colors, flat storybook style. No signs, no flags, no emblems, no text.

items.title: 소품 — 차용증 (빌려준 돈 종이)
items.motion: 이웃 아저씨 손에서 화이트보드 위로 날아와 붙는다.
items.desc: A single sheet of paper with a few blank lines and a small drawn stack of coins in the corner, a little crumpled, with a blank signature line at the bottom. No text, no numbers.

items.title: 소품 — 민사 길 (소장 → 법원 → 판결 → 집행)
items.motion: 형사 말판 옆에 훨씬 짧게 붙는다. 서류가 칸을 건너간다.
items.desc: A short board-game path drawn in marker on a whiteboard: only four rounded green squares connected by an arrow in a straight line from left to right, much shorter than a long path; each square contains one tiny blank icon: a paper, a small courthouse, a gavel, a small coin bag. Marker-drawn friendly look on a plain white background. No text, no numbers.

items.title: 소품 — 역할 카드 네 장 (경찰 · 중수청 · 검사 · 판사)
items.motion: 간판 아래로 한 장씩 탁탁 놓인다. 판사 카드만 처음부터 반짝. 글자는 영상에서.
items.desc: Four blank rounded playing cards laid side by side in a row, each a different soft color (blue, purple, green, gold), each with a plain simple icon at the top and an empty text area below: a magnifying glass, a shield-shaped blank badge with no emblem, a document with a pointing hand, a balance scale. The fourth gold card has tiny sparkle marks. No text, no emblems, no logos.

items.title: 소품 — CCTV 모니터 속 공원 벤치와 자전거
items.motion: 모니터가 돌아오며 커진다. 7편 공원 배경과 같은 벤치.
items.desc: A computer monitor seen straight-on whose screen shows a slightly grainy, gray-green security-camera view from above of a quiet park: a wooden bench with a small red child's bicycle leaning against it, grass and a path. A corner timestamp bar shown only as a blank rectangle. No text.

items.title: 무대 — 법정 (판사석 · 검사석 · 변호인석 · 피고인석)
items.motion: 오른쪽으로 천천히 밀린다. 판사석이 가장 높다. 사람들은 얼굴 없는 작은 실루엣.
items.desc: A calm Korean courtroom seen straight-on, wide 16:9: a high judge's bench at the back center with a plain chair, a prosecutor's table on the left, a defense table on the right, a witness stand, wooden railings and a few rows of gallery benches. A few very small faceless simple silhouettes sit at the tables. Warm wooden tones, soft light from tall windows. No flags, no emblems, no signs, no readable text, nothing scary.

items.title: 무대 — 간판 바뀌는 날 (빈 간판 하나 내려가고 둘 올라감)
items.motion: 가운데 간판이 아래로 내려가고 양옆으로 새 간판 두 개가 올라온다. 글자는 영상에서(기관 로고 없음).
items.desc: A wide 16:9 street view of the front of a large plain government-style building in early autumn daylight. In the center a big blank sign board is being lowered by two small workers on a lift, and on either side two new blank sign boards of different soft colors are being raised on ropes, pulleys and ladders. Small faceless silhouettes of workers and a few passers-by watch from the sidewalk. No text, no emblems, no flags, no logos, no real building details.

items.title: 한 장 장면 — 다음 편 예고
items.motion: 다음 편 주제가 정해지면 그린다.
items.desc: TO BE DECIDED once the next episode's topic is chosen. Placeholder: a warm, empty park bench at sunset with a small red bicycle leaning against it and two ice-cream cones on the seat. 16:9, no people, no text.
